frame: heliocentric ecliptic J2000 (same as JPL); AU, degrees, JD TDB
how_to: elliptic: M = M_deg + n_deg_day*(t - epoch_jd_tdb); solve E - e*sin(E) = M; x' = a(cos E - e), y' = a*sqrt(1-e^2)*sin E. hyperbolic: M = n_deg_day*(t - tp_jd_tdb) (radians!); solve e*sinh(H) - H = M; a = q/(1-e) < 0; x' = a(cosh H - e), y' = -a*sqrt(e^2-1)*sinh H. Then rotate (x', y', 0) by peri, inclination, node (see the contract). t = JD TDB (UTC + 69.2 s).

source.planets: NASA JPL Horizons API (ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api) (osculating elements, planet centres)
